how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-dun-morogh-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:287:obj:0: Explore Frostmane Hold, and kill 5 Frostmane Headhunters for Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.
rows.quest:287:details:0: I'm behind on my report, and could use your help, ⟦1⟧. I just managed to find where the trolls are holed up, but I saw so many trolls, I was afraid to go in.
rows.quest:287:details:1: BHere's what I need... Go down to the cave, poke around inside, kill a few of the trolls, then come back here.
rows.quest:287:details:2: BTake the road north out of Kharanos, when you get to the bridge, follow the frozen river west until you reach Iceflow Lake. You'll find Brewnall Village on the west bank. The Hold is southwest of the village.
rows.quest:287:completion:0: Ah, ⟦2⟧! I didn't think you'd have much trouble finding the place, my directions are excellent, you know...
rows.quest:287:completion:1: BLet me just finish up my report then.
rows.quest:287:completion:2: B<He brings out some paper and scribbles on it momentarily.>
rows.quest:287:completion:3: BThere! Well, haha, now this certainly is funny... I don't suppose, ⟦3⟧, that you would mind doing one last favor for me?
rows.quest:291:obj:0: Deliver Senir's report to Senator Barin Redstone in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:291:details:0: Excellent! Take my report to Senator Barin Redstone. He's a sour type, so don't let his less-than-sunny disposition get to you. He's in ⟦E1⟧, in the chamber where King Magni holds court.
rows.quest:291:details:1: BDon't know the way to ⟦E1⟧? Take the road out of Kharanos north, cross the bridge, then follow the road east--there are large banners flanking the road--up the mountainside.
rows.quest:291:details:2: BBy the way, if you might avoid mentioning how you assisted me? Can't let them think I'm not working hard out here, you know?
rows.quest:291:completion:1: BAuthority of the KING!? Has Magni taken complete leave of his senses! And that damnable Whitebeard... Taken matters into his own hands, has he? The Senate will not be pleased to hear about this, not one bit.
rows.quest:291:completion:2: BWhat, are you still here? Go, before I call the guards!
rows.quest:310:obj:0: In the basement of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, replace a barrel of Thunder Ale with a Barrel of Barleybrew Scalder.
rows.quest:310:details:0: I have to admit, those Thunderbrews make some good drinks. But they need to learn that theirs isn't the only decent brew! Maybe you can help me teach them that lesson...
rows.quest:310:details:1: BHere, take this barrel of Barleybrew Scalder. Sneak into the basement of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos and switch it with one of their barrels of Thunder Ale. Then we'll see how their patrons like my brew over theirs!
rows.quest:310:details:2: BAnd if the barrels are guarded, then you might have to distract the guard ...
rows.quest:310:completion:0: You quickly place Marleth's barrel of Barleybrew Scalder among the Thunderbrew barrels.
rows.quest:311:obj:0: Bring the barrel of Thunder Ale to Marleth Barleybrew at the Brewnall Village.
rows.quest:311:details:0: Having inserted a barrel of Marleth's Scalder in the Kharanos Distillery's cellar, you grab a barrel of Thunder Ale as proof of the deed...
rows.quest:311:completion:0: Not bad, ⟦5⟧! Did you have a hard time getting past their guard?
rows.quest:311:completion:1: BNo matter - many thanks, and if you're ever in need of stout with a kick, don't forget the Barleybrews!
rows.quest:312:obj:0: Retrieve Tundra MacGrann's dried meats from the stolen meat locker in Old Icebeard's cave.
rows.quest:312:details:0: I had a month's worth of dried meats salted and locked away for the cold season. Kept it locked so the bears wouldn't get it! But while I was off hunting deer, that beast, Old Icebeard, made off with the meat locker. He won't be able to smash through that Thorium though. But I'll starve if I can't get my meats back.
rows.quest:312:details:1: BYou seem a bit more stealthy than me. Perhaps you can retrieve my stash? I'll never make it in and out of that cave fast enough with this bum leg of mine.
rows.quest:312:completion:0: What a kind soul you are, ⟦6⟧! Thanks to your bravery I won't find myself starving when the cold season flurries blow in.
rows.quest:313:obj:0: Gather 8 Wendigo Manes and bring them to Pilot Stonegear.
rows.quest:313:details:0: Driving a Siege Engine isn't for everyone. It takes an iron grip and nerves of steel...lucky I have both! How about you? How's your mettle? Want to prove it to me?
rows.quest:313:details:1: BWell...I'm looking to make my engine, Trollplow, a little more cozy. How about you get me a heap of Wendigo Manes from the Grizzled Den, west of Kharanos. Those manes would make a great rug for Trollplow's inside deck!
rows.quest:313:completion:0: Ah yes, these manes will work great! You show a lot of grit, ⟦7⟧ - I wager we'll see great things from you.
rows.quest:314:obj:0: Rudra Amberstill wants you to slay Vagash and bring his fang to her at the Ram ranch.
rows.quest:314:details:0: We heard the cries in the middle of the night. Then this morning, sure enough, the herd was missing two rams. That dastardly beast known as Vagash has been preying on our livelihood. With most of King Magni's army off in distant lands fighting with the ⟦E2⟧, there is no one to keep Vagash at bay.
rows.quest:314:details:1: BPerhaps you are brave enough to seek out the beast and slay him. Bring me one of his fangs and I will reward you. Vagash lurks just above the ranch here, but be warned, he is deadly.
rows.quest:314:completion:0: Very well done! Veron will be so happy when he hears the good news. To kill Vagash is no easy task. I imagine one day you'll be fighting alongside King Magni's men on the ⟦E2⟧ Front.
rows.quest:315:obj:0: Bring 6 Shimmerweeds to Rejold Barleybrew in the Brewnall Village.
rows.quest:315:details:0: I'm on a quest, a quest to make the perfect stout. I know I can do it -- brewing's in my blood. I just need to find the right recipe...
rows.quest:315:details:1: BThe Frostmane trolls grow a plant, shimmerweed, high up in the hills to the east. They use it in their strange, tribal rituals. We dwarves haven't found much use for it, but it has a unique taste...and I want to experiment with it in my brews!
rows.quest:315:details:2: BGet me some shimmerweed from Frostmane seers, or swipe it from the trolls' shimmerweed baskets.
rows.quest:315:completion:0: Great! I can't wait to use these in some of my recipes. There's one in particular I think it'll work great in...
rows.quest:317:obj:0: Gather 4 Chunks of Boar Meat and 2 Thick Bear Furs, and deliver them to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.
rows.quest:317:details:0: I'm preparing to start a mission for the Siege Brigade. It's a long one, and I need to stock Jetsteam with a month's worth of supplies. So while Steelgrill is working on my tank, can you do some hunting for me?
rows.quest:317:details:1: BI'll need some fur for bedding, and boar meat for food. You can get meat from boars and fur from the bears... you can find them both in the snow fields south of the Grizzled Den.
rows.quest:317:completion:0: By Magni's beard, you sure did a lot of hunting!! Thank you, ⟦8⟧.
rows.quest:318:obj:0: Get a cask of Evershine from Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village.
rows.quest:318:details:0: Rejold Barleybrew experiments with his brews. Some of them taste good, some bad, and some...well, some will lay all but the stoutest dwarf flat.
rows.quest:318:details:1: BHe lives at Brewnall Village, west of Kharanos, and one of his drinks, Evershine, is what I want. It'll help keep me warm while I'm on the cold road.
rows.quest:318:details:2: BAnd...the blessed stuff burns so hot I can throw it in Jetsteam's furnace for a burst of power! That little tactic has gotten me out of more than one tight spot.
rows.quest:318:completion:0: Bellowfiz needs some of my Evershine? Hm...all right.
rows.quest:319:obj:0: Kill 6 Ice ⟦E3⟧ Bears, 8 Elder Crag Boars, and 8 Snow Leopards, and then return to Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village.
rows.quest:319:details:0: I have a cask of Evershine handy, but...can you do me a favor? Brewnall village could use a hand against the wild animals that wander the nearby snows. Sometimes they wander close.
rows.quest:319:details:1: BWe're not afraid of these bears and cats and boars - no self respecting dwarf would be - but if you can take care of those animals for us, then we'd have more time for our crafting and brewing.
rows.quest:319:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦9⟧. It'll be nice to work our crafts without hearing so many growls and snorts outside the village.
rows.quest:320:obj:0: Give the cask of Evershine to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.
rows.quest:320:details:0: Here's your cask of Evershine, ⟦10⟧. And again, thank you for the hunting earlier.
rows.quest:320:completion:0: Yes, this will do just fine. I think I'll open a bottle right now and have a taste...
rows.quest:384:obj:0: Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos wants 6 Crag Boar Ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt.
rows.quest:384:details:0: Nothing my tavern patrons enjoy more than some Beer Basted Boar Ribs! Only problem is, the local trapper who used to bring me supplies enlisted in the King's Army to help with the war on the ⟦E2⟧ front.
rows.quest:384:details:1: BMaybe you can help me out? If you bring me six crag boar ribs and a Rhapsody Malt from the tavern here, I'll give you the family recipe for my famous Beer Basted Boar Ribs, not to mention a free sample! The secret's in the Malt!
rows.quest:384:completion:0: The Malt is brewed, the Boars are dead⟦11⟧And before all is done and anything said⟦12⟧We will have to fight for first dibs⟦13⟧On these savory Beer Basted Boar Ribs!
rows.quest:400:obj:0: Deliver Steelgrill's Tools to Beldin Steelgrill.
rows.quest:400:details:0: Beldin Steelgrill owns the local mechanic shop, and he's the best siege engine tech there is! But he's not forgiving to his tools. I swear he almost breaks more arclight spanners than we can supply him with!
rows.quest:400:details:1: BWe just filled his last order for tools. If you deliver it to him I'm sure he'll make it worth the effort.
rows.quest:400:details:2: BHis shop, Steelgrill's Depot, is just northeast of Kharanos. And it's a local haunt for veteran siege engine pilots, so keep your ears open for opportunities while you're there.
rows.quest:400:completion:0: You have my tools? Well done, lad, well done! I just broke my last fang-ratchet an hour ago and I need one of those to finish repairs on Pilot Stonegear's siege engine. You did a good thing by lugging those tools here, ⟦14⟧.
rows.quest:400:completion:1: BHere, take these coins for your help.
rows.quest:412:obj:0: Bring Razzle Sprysprocket in Kharanos 8 Restabilization Cogs and 8 Gyromechanic Gears.
rows.quest:412:details:0: Upon further analysis of the Gnomeregan situation, it would appear as though we not only failed to eradicate the troggs but we also happened to turn most of the gnomish race into horrific, mindless, evil-doing leper gnomes.
rows.quest:412:details:1: BOzzie and I plan to reverse the horrible leper effect with our latest invention: The Recombobulator. The machine is almost complete but we are in dire need of some Restabilization Cogs and Gyromechanic Gears. Retrieve some from the leper gnomes out front of Gnomeregan for us.
rows.quest:412:completion:0: These Gyromechanic Gears and Restabilization Cogs are in perfect accordance with Ozzie's schematics for the Recombobulation Device. Once I add some hyrdolubricant to the inner combustion pistons, adjust the crank-o-ratchet and increase of the viscosity of the electrogum gel, the gnomish race will be as good as new.
rows.quest:413:obj:0: Take the Barrel of Shimmer Stout to Mountaineer Barleybrew.
rows.quest:413:details:0: I'd like my brother Wellart to try my new Shimmer Stout. He's a Mountaineer stationed in the southern guard tower, one of two towers on the border to ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:413:details:1: BHe may not be a brewer like the rest of us Barleybrews, but he loves his drinks and I know he'll like this one.
rows.quest:413:details:2: BCan you bring him this Barrel of Shimmer Stout for me?
rows.quest:413:completion:1: BOh. Whoa! This stuff really puts a shine in your eyes. I feel like I can see in the dark!
rows.quest:414:obj:0: Take the Cask of Shimmer Stout to Mountaineer Kadrell.
rows.quest:414:details:0: I've been drinking more of that Shimmer Stout my brother made - it's great stuff! I want a fellow Mountaineer to try it. His name's Kadrell, and he's usually patrolling the road through Thelsamar in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:414:details:1: BTo get to Thelsamar, go southeast through the tunnel, then turn northeast when the path forks into a road. Follow that road straight into Thelsamar.
rows.quest:414:details:2: BGive Mountaineer Kadrell this cask of Shimmer Stout and see what he thinks!
rows.quest:414:completion:0: Now, let me have a taste...
rows.quest:414:completion:1: BMagni's Beard! This stuff gets your head turning! And it lightens the limbs, too.
rows.quest:414:completion:2: BI feel like I can fly!
rows.quest:415:details:0: Rejold Barleybrew at Brewnall Village has been asking for you.
rows.quest:415:details:1: BHe wants to talk to you about a new drink he's been brewing...said something about you helping him with it. You might want to head back to Brewnall Village and see what he has to say.
rows.quest:415:details:2: BThere could be some free booze in it for you...
rows.quest:415:completion:0: ⟦15⟧! You know that Shimmerweed you brought me? Well I used it in a few recipes I've been working on, and one of them turned out great!
rows.quest:415:completion:1: BHere, try it out and tell me what you think...
rows.quest:417:obj:1: BBring his Mangy ⟦E3⟧ and Hildelve's Journal to Pilot Hammerfoot.
rows.quest:417:details:0: Hildelve wrote in his journal that he was attacked by Mangeclaw, a "huge Ice ⟦E3⟧ Bear." He drove off the beast, but not before it mauled him savagely.
rows.quest:417:details:1: BJudging from the state of Hildelve's body, Mangeclaw must have later returned and killed him.
rows.quest:417:details:2: BHowever, Hildelve wrote in his journal his one, final wish:
rows.quest:417:completion:0: This is grim news, for Hildelve was a good friend. And I wish I could have been there with you when you found the beast, Mangeclaw!
rows.quest:417:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦16⟧. Your deed will be remembered by the pilots of the ⟦E1⟧ Siege Brigade.
rows.quest:419:details:0: My friend and fellow Siege Engine pilot, Mori Hildelve, is lost in the hills. We were looking for a rare ore that's needed for a high-grade blastpowder, and during our search he drove his engine up a steep hill and busted it!
rows.quest:419:details:1: BStill convinced that ore was in these mountains, Hildelve charged me to guard our engines while he continued on foot, searching.
rows.quest:419:details:2: BIt's been days, and I've heard some beastly growls in the hills at night. Mori's tough as nails, but I'm worried.
rows.quest:419:completion:0: Here is the corpse of a dwarf -- mauled, frozen, and picked clean by mountain scavengers. Clutched in its hand is a book containing the roughly scribbled notes of Mori Hildelve. And around its frame, still in superior condition, is a Brigadier's Vest.
rows.quest:419:completion:1: BThis grisly scene must have been where the Siege Engine pilot met his end.
rows.quest:432:obj:0: Kill 6 Rockjaw Skullthumpers for ⟦E5⟧ Stonebrow at the Gol'Bolar quarry.
rows.quest:432:details:0: Those Light-blasted troggs, turning my work site into a wreck! Look at that, there goes another barrel of powder!
rows.quest:432:details:1: BOhhh, I wish I could go down there and wring every one of their scrawny little necks! I want to kill them all!
rows.quest:432:details:2: BThis can't be good for my health, all this stress and anger... What have they left me with? Nothing!
rows.quest:432:details:3: BI'd kill them myself, but my aim's no good anymore! You go into the quarry and kill some of the filthy buggers! I'll pay you! Just hurt them, kill them!
rows.quest:432:completion:0: Well, that makes me feel a little better...
rows.quest:432:completion:1: BBut I won't be happy until they're all dead! All of them!
rows.quest:433:obj:0: Kill 10 Rockjaw Bonesnappers for Senator Mehr Stonehallow at the Gol'Bolar quarry.
rows.quest:433:details:0: As a member of the Senate and the Explorers' League, I've taken it upon myself to take care of this part of the trogg infestation that has gripped our lands.
rows.quest:433:details:1: BThey've certainly made a mess of Gol'Bolar quarry, and for no reason. As we dug deep into the earth, they poured out, destroying our equipment and driving the miners out. There's not much for us to do but to exterminate the lot of them, rebuild, then get back to work.
rows.quest:433:details:2: BIf you help me with the troggs, I'll gladly recompense you for your time.
rows.quest:433:completion:0: It is a start. Hopefully we can take advantage of it, and move some Mountaineers in to secure the area. Then we can begin to restore our infrastructure and get the miners back to work.
rows.quest:466:obj:0: Bring 6 loads of Incendicite Ore to Pilot Stonegear in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:466:details:0: I heard that a rare ore, incendicite, was found in the ⟦E7⟧, in a cave northwest of Algaz Gate. Incendicite is volatile stuff and hard to use without blowing yourself up, but I'm sure if it's smelted the right way it could make cannon shells that pack a mighty punch!
rows.quest:466:details:1: BGet me incendicite ore and I'll find someone brave enough to experiment with it.
rows.quest:466:details:2: BOh, and to extract that ore from a vein you'll need skill in mining. If you don't have it, then ... bring a friend who does to that cave!
rows.quest:466:completion:0: You got the ore! Well done, ⟦19⟧! I'll get someone to work with this right away. Let's hope he doesn't blow himself up!
rows.quest:467:details:0: Pilot Stonegear loves his siege engine, as every pilot should! And he's always eager to find new ways to improve his tank's firepower!
rows.quest:467:details:1: BHe heard rumors of a rare ore and is looking for someone to hunt it down for him. If your boots are starting to itch, then find Stonegear at Steelgrill's Depot in ⟦E6⟧ and see what he wants.
rows.quest:467:completion:0: Hello ⟦20⟧. You're here about the task I have, eh? It's good to see a young ⟦21⟧ like yourself whose blood burns at the prospect of adventure!
rows.quest:2160:obj:0: Deliver the Crate of Inn Supplies to Tannok Frosthammer in Kharanos.
rows.quest:2160:details:0: Hey! You look like a hearty adventurer. If you're planning on braving the pass, do you suppose you could bring a package to the inn in Kharanos?
rows.quest:2160:details:1: BYou were planning on stopping at the inn, right? If you make it through the pass, you'll definitely want to take a breather there.
rows.quest:2160:details:2: BAnyways, bring this to Tannok Frosthammer, the innkeeper's assistant. I can't get through the pass myself, and it'll be days until a Mountaineer escort comes through!
rows.quest:2160:completion:0: Ah, at last, the supplies from Hands! I was beginning to worry, we've had scarce word from Anvilmar ever since the troggs overran the pass.
rows.quest:2160:completion:1: BThanks for bring this to me, ⟦22⟧. And please, make yourself comfortable. You must be tired after your journey.
rows.quest:5541:obj:0: Bring Rumbleshot's Ammo to Hegnar Rumbleshot in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:5541:details:0: Hegnar Rumbleshot sells guns off the road to Anvilmar. Riflemen and mortar teams spend a lot of time practicing out near his shop, and he's always needing fresh ammunition.
rows.quest:5541:details:1: BBut... the last crate of ammo I sent him got lost along the way. My courier said he was camped near the Grizzled Den when wendigo chased him away... and the fool left Rumbleshot's ammo behind!
rows.quest:5541:details:2: B⟦23⟧, can you get that ammo and take it to Rumbleshot? He's been waiting on it and I'm sure he's running low.
rows.quest:5541:completion:0: Great, more ammo! Old Loslor's shipment finally came through! The ammo might be late, but just like my grand daddy used to tell me: late's better than never!
rows.quest:5541:completion:1: BThank you much, ⟦24⟧. I already have buyers eager for this stuff!
